title: When the Protocol Falls Anew
author: Marguerite Amberdale
blurb: Coral Yarrow, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
